items.stem: A consultant is told 'reps keep skipping key stages.' What is the best first design response?

options.text: Immediately build a complex approval process
options.rationale: Building before understanding the process risks solving the wrong problem.

options.text: Confirm the intended sales process, then consider guided paths or validation
options.rationale: Correct: confirm the process first, then apply paths/validation to enforce stage discipline.
Removing the core object is not a valid response.

options.text: Tell reps to try harder with no config change
options.rationale: Ignoring tooling options is not a consultant solution.

items.explanation: Correct: confirm the process first, then apply paths/validation to enforce stage discipline.

items.stem: Which feature best enforces that a required field is completed before an opportunity can be marked Closed Won?

options.rationale: Report subscriptions distribute reports; they do not enforce data entry.
Correct: a validation rule can block the save unless the required condition is met at that stage.
A list view only changes what records are displayed.
Chatter is collaboration, not data enforcement.

items.stem: Which TWO are appropriate ways to measure meaningful Sales Cloud adoption?

options.text: Percentage of opportunities with up-to-date next steps
options.rationale: Correct: data completeness on active deals reflects real adoption.

options.text: Share of deals logged in Salesforce vs spreadsheets
options.rationale: Correct: migration of work into the platform is a meaningful adoption signal.

options.text: Total number of page scrolls per user
options.rationale: Scroll counts are vanity metrics, not meaningful adoption.
Login screen counts do not indicate adoption.

items.explanation: Correct: data completeness on active deals reflects real adoption.
